purpose: Canonical synthesis of gameplay-facing, presentation, renderer, third-party, platform, and unresolved boundaries between Spore gameplay and the original RenderWare/D3D presentation stack.

boundaries.boundary: Cell animation clip selection and blend-transition state
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell gameplay, interaction, and entity-state paths call Simulator::Cell::PlayAnimation; forty-four static direct-call xrefs exist but the exact runtime event producer is unresolved.
boundaries.original_callee: Simulator::Cell::PlayAnimation and FUN_00e6d180, FUN_00e563e0, FUN_00b72210, and FUN_00e4f330
state_changed: cCellObjectData animation flag and blend fields
boundaries.lifetime: Clip and transition state belongs to the pooled Cell object until the Cell is rebuilt, released, rebound to a model, or explicitly changes clip state.
boundaries.failure_semantics: The function no-ops when model identity or the Cell GFX association is absent; invalid clips, interruption, loop exhaustion, and callback failure are unresolved.
boundaries.timing_order: Guard valid model and presentation association, derive blend times, apply transition special cases, scale times, dispatch the request, then write Cell animation state.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Gameplay-owned animation intent: current clip, target clip, transition policy, and deterministic phase state.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IAnimationController with typed clip IDs, transition policy, time scale, and a state snapshot before pose evaluation.
boundaries.notes: Static decompilation strongly supports blend calculation and state writes; it does not validate event causality or final pose output.

boundaries.boundary: Camera-ray to movement-plane result and Cell target mutation
boundaries.gameplay_caller: App::cCellModeStrategy::Update reaches Simulator::Cell::MovePlayerToMousePosition through the Cell update body.
boundaries.original_callee: Graphics::IRenderer::Get, renderer Layer access, FUN_007c4900, App::cViewer camera-to-point/mouse helpers, and the ray-plane calculation in MovePlayerToMousePosition
parameters: camera origin and normalized ray direction
boundaries.lifetime: The camera query is frame-scoped; target position and orientation persist until the next movement update or gameplay mutation.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Movement no-ops for lock, invalid player, UI or camera-mode gates, invalid denominator, or negative ray-plane distance; target state is left unchanged on failure.
boundaries.timing_order: Route current pointer state, resolve the camera frame, produce origin and ray, intersect the gameplay movement plane, then write target position, travel orientation, and moving state.
boundaries.openspore_concept: A read-only camera-ray provider consumed by movement, with ray-plane intersection performed as gameplay logic.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: ICameraRayProvider and IPlayerMovement over a documented CameraState coordinate convention and explicit movement-plane result.
boundaries.notes: This is the strongest gameplay-hidden-behind-Graphics case: the semantic result is the target mutation, not the renderer accessor.

boundaries.boundary: Active-mode input routing, pointer picks, and Cell UI selection transitions
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Input manager dispatch to App::cCellModeStrategy pointer and key callbacks, followed by cCellGame and cCellUI consumers.
boundaries.original_callee: cCellModeStrategy::OnMouseMove, OnMouseDown, OnMouseUp, OnMouseWheel, OnKeyDown, Graphics::IRenderer Layer, FUN_007c4900, and Cell spatial-query helpers
outputs: Cell UI hover and selection state
Cell query hit or candidate handle
boundaries.lifetime: Pointer interaction state is per event; mode-local input and selection persist across frames until changed or the mode exits.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Callbacks return false when not consumed; failed pointer queries clear or leave selection unset; several field meanings and routing bits remain unresolved.
boundaries.timing_order: Normalize platform input, route to the active mode, query camera and Cell space, update gameplay or UI selection state, then apply it in the Cell update.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Typed input events and a mode-owned Cell interaction state that can feed gameplay without exposing UI widgets or renderer layers.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IInputRouter, IModeInputState, and ICellPickQuery with explicit consumed, selected, and no-hit outcomes.
boundaries.notes: Input and selection are gameplay-relevant transitions. Which cCellUI fields are read by simulation rather than only consumed by presentation is not established.

boundaries.boundary: Game-mode transition and Cell mode ownership lifecycle
boundaries.gameplay_caller: App::cGameModeManager changes the active mode, then the selected mode drives per-frame input, simulation, display, exit, and disposal.
boundaries.original_callee: App::cGameModeManager::SetActiveModeAt and App::cCellModeStrategy::Initialize, OnEnter, Update, OnExit, and Dispose
outputs: Cell simulation and display update frames
old-mode exit and new-mode entry transition
state_changed: Cell frame and background presentation state
Cell game, CellGFX, and CellUI singleton ownership
Cell mode initialized and entered flags
boundaries.lifetime: A mode owns its gameplay and presentation state from initialization through disposal; display activation is normally bounded by entry and exit.
boundaries.failure_semantics: The original manager body is boundary-damaged and provides little explicit error propagation; partial initialization must not be treated as display-ready.
boundaries.timing_order: Initialize, exit the old mode, enter the new mode, update gameplay and presentation, exit on transition, then dispose mode-owned state before global renderer shutdown.
boundaries.openspore_concept: An explicit mode transition and lifetime boundary that orders gameplay, presentation, input routing, and resource retirement.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IGameModeRegistry and IGameMode with initialize, onEnter, update, onExit, and dispose transitions plus idempotent teardown.
boundaries.notes: The old-exit/new-enter contract is strongly supported, but the exact complete transition path is static and not a runtime trace.

boundaries.boundary: Stable content, model, material, texture, and effect identity selection
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell creation and cCellGFX preload traverse Cell, Populate, effect-map, and nested resource records to select visual content.
boundaries.original_callee: Simulator::Cell::GetModelKeyForCellResource and cCellGFX preload helpers for models, textures, effects, creatures, and populate records
parameters: model, material, texture, effect, and creature identity
boundaries.lifetime: Resource identities are stable content values; the visual handles acquired for them have independent stage or cache lifetime.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Unknown record types and missing nested records can select defaults, skip preload entries, or yield absent presentation state; the original aggregate status is not consistent.
boundaries.timing_order: Resolve content keys before acquiring models, textures, effects, or meshes, then retain those handles across preload-to-display use.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Content identity as immutable typed keys, separate from loaded model, material, texture, mesh, and presentation handles.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IContentStore, IModelKeyResolver, IMaterialIntent, and typed ResourceKey, MaterialId, and TextureKey values.
boundaries.notes: Identity is a semantic asset contract. Exact record meaning, material-slot mapping, and original cache priority remain separate questions.

boundaries.boundary: Editor creature target motion, clip, event, and pose-intent state
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Editor mode selection, cEditorAnimWorld target setters, EditorCreatureController updates, and editor animation event commands.
boundaries.original_callee: Editors::cEditor::SetActiveMode, cEditorAnimWorld setters, EditorCreatureController::Update, AnimatedCreature and IAnimWorld vtables, and cEditorAnimEvent MessageSend or MessagePost
parameters: animation event identity and scalar parameters
boundaries.lifetime: Controller and animation intent live with the editor creature binding; event payload lifetime and queue ownership are unresolved.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Missing creature or controller entries become no-ops; event IDs, queue priority, completion, and exact pose side effects are not characterized.
boundaries.timing_order: Clean the old editor mode, install creature and target state, dispatch ordered animation commands, then update and render the resulting editor view.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Editor-owned creature motion, animation intent, and mode state with pose evaluation behind an adapter.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IEditorCreatureController and IAnimationEventSink over typed target state, event ordering, and explicit missing-target results.
boundaries.notes: This is editor semantic state, not evidence that the same controller drives Cell creatures.

boundaries.boundary: Gameplay-owned local, parent, and world transform composition
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell and entity construction, movement, animation, model attachment, editor creature controllers, and presentation snapshot code compose transforms.
boundaries.original_callee: Transform::PreTransformBy, Transform::ToMatrix4, and local transform math helpers
boundaries.lifetime: Transform values are value state embedded in entities, models, camera state, and presentation records until recomputed.
boundaries.failure_semantics: The helpers expose no typed error path; invalid or denormal transform handling and exact normalization order are unresolved.
boundaries.timing_order: Compose authoritative entity transforms during gameplay, snapshot after movement and animation, then convert to a render matrix at the presentation boundary.
boundaries.openspore_concept: A backend-neutral AffineTransform carrying gameplay position, orientation, scale, and deterministic composition order.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: AffineTransform with compose, inverse, transformPoint, and transformDirection operations independent of the original 56-byte layout.
boundaries.notes: Preserve coordinate handedness and composition order, not original flags, storage layout, or helper ABI.

boundaries.boundary: Gameplay Cell identity to replaceable presentation-handle association
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Simulator::Cell::CreateCellObject and Cell lifecycle paths create, rebuild, and release renderer-facing associations for pooled gameplay objects.
boundaries.original_callee: FUN_00e6d8f0, cObjectPool CellGFXObjectData allocation, cCellObjectData GFX-index helpers, and reciprocal CellGFXObjectData model or creature links
boundaries.lifetime: Gameplay Cell identity persists in its gameplay pool; its presentation handle can be detached, rebuilt, or released independently.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Missing handles are treated as detached; pool exhaustion is inferred to be a fatal invariant violation; individual component-release failures are not fully characterized.
boundaries.timing_order: Create or rebuild the gameplay Cell, allocate and populate its presentation representation, establish reciprocal links, and invalidate only the presentation link during removal.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Stable gameplay EntityId with an optional PresentationHandle that can be rebuilt without changing simulation identity.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IEntityPresentationRegistry with attach, rebuild, detach, and idempotent invalidation operations.
boundaries.notes: The reciprocal association is strong static evidence; exact helper intent and pre-load versus immediate allocation remain address-addressed.

boundaries.boundary: Vehicle identity, locomotion, and model-transform intent
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Simulator::cCity::SpawnVehicle, Simulator::cVehicle::Load, and cLocomotiveObject movement or model updates.
boundaries.original_callee: Simulator::cVehicle and cLocomotiveObject movement and model virtuals
boundaries.lifetime: Vehicle objects live from city spawn and load through locomotion updates until their owning city or game-data container destroys them.
boundaries.failure_semantics: The original Load and spawn bodies are unavailable; invalid references, unloaded models, teleport, and transform-update failure behavior are unresolved.
boundaries.timing_order: Spawn and load vehicle state, apply locomotion, mark model transform dirty, then let presentation consume the current transform snapshot; pose coupling is unknown.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Vehicle locomotion and transform intent owned by gameplay, independent of the visual model and any animation backend.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IVehicleState with typed locomotion fields, model binding, and an explicit transform-dirty transition.
boundaries.notes: Vehicle locomotion is semantic; no direct vehicle-to-animation or pose edge is established.

boundaries.boundary: Animation manager, animation world, and animated-creature engine wrappers
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell, editor creature, and mode update paths use animation services to express clip, loop, blend, creature, and pose requests.
boundaries.original_callee: Anim::IAnimManager::Get, AnimatedCreature vtable methods, Anim::IAnimWorld::Update, UpdateCreatures, PostUpdateCreatures, and model-world animation operations
parameters: mode, idle, loop, and loop-count values
boundaries.lifetime: The service is application-scoped; clip state follows a controller or Cell; pose buffers follow the model instance or animation world.
boundaries.failure_semantics: The accessor can return the current global pointer; most implementation bodies and missing-clip, interruption, loop, and phase failure paths are unavailable.
boundaries.timing_order: Fetch or inject the service, apply gameplay clip and transition intent, update animation worlds and creatures in explicit phases, snapshot pose, then submit presentation.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Injected animation services expressing gameplay-owned transitions while hiding manager and evaluator objects.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IAnimationService, IAnimationController, and IAnimationWorld with explicit update phases and PoseSnapshot output.
boundaries.notes: The wrapper surface is known, but the exact pose-update ordering and implementation semantics are not.

boundaries.boundary: Active camera, viewer frame, projection, viewport, and pointer-ray service
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Mode setup selects cameras; Cell movement, pointer picking, editor tools, and editor creature controllers query camera and layer state.
boundaries.original_callee: App::cCameraManager camera-selection methods, App::cViewer camera and projection methods, cMouseCamera input methods, and GetCameraToPoint or GetCameraToMouse helpers
state_changed: view, projection, viewport, and clip state
boundaries.lifetime: Camera services and registries are application-scoped; the active viewer and camera frame are mode- or frame-scoped.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Named camera misses report failure; invalid viewer or graphics-state creation can stop setup; no typed error exists for a missing camera ray in the exported helper.
boundaries.timing_order: Apply input, select the active camera, finalize view and projection, then expose the same immutable camera snapshot to gameplay queries and rendering.
boundaries.openspore_concept: A coherent CameraState and camera service shared by gameplay queries and frame rendering.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: ICameraService, ICameraController, CameraState, ProjectionState, and ICameraRayProvider with documented coordinate conventions.
boundaries.notes: The service is gameplay-relevant because gameplay reads its state. Exact follow, handedness, and unprojection details remain unresolved.

boundaries.boundary: Cell resource preload and presentation association service
boundaries.gameplay_caller: App::cCellModeStrategy::OnEnter preloads Cell and Populate resources before individual entities receive visual representations.
boundaries.original_callee: cCellGFX::PreloadResources, PreloadCellResource, PreloadPopulateResource, PreloadCreature, AddPreloadedModel, AddPreloadedTexture, AddPreloadedEffect, and GetModelKeyForCellResource
parameters: model, texture, effect, and creature keys
boundaries.lifetime: Preload collections belong to the Cell stage and outlive individual presentation views; loaded handles remain valid until stage teardown or last-owner release.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Null models, zero identities, unsupported records, and failed child references are often skipped or logged; modern code should expose missing, unreadable, and timeout results explicitly.
boundaries.timing_order: Initialize scene services, walk content records, recursively acquire and deduplicate dependencies, publish readiness, bind resources, then activate display.
boundaries.openspore_concept: A stage-owned content preload catalog keyed by stable identity and independent from entity ownership.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IContentPreloader and IPresentationResourceCache with preloadModel, preloadCreature, preloadTexture, preloadEffect, readiness, and typed errors.
boundaries.notes: The original traversal and ordering are required; decompiler-ambiguous container and refcount layouts are not ABI requirements.

boundaries.boundary: Gameplay Cell snapshot to model, animation, opacity, and visibility view
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell updates and animation transitions provide transform, opacity, clip, scale, and visibility intent to each presentation association.
boundaries.original_callee: FUN_00e5e590, Simulator::Cell::PlayAnimation, Graphics::IModelWorld animation and group-transform virtuals, and Simulator::IGameDataView model and visibility methods
parameters: animation ID, mode, transition, and loop
boundaries.lifetime: The snapshot is per frame and tied to a presentation handle; it is discarded or reset when that view is detached.
boundaries.failure_semantics: A missing view or presentation handle makes propagation a no-op while gameplay state continues; exact opacity and visibility readers are unresolved.
boundaries.timing_order: Update authoritative gameplay state, synchronize the immutable view snapshot, evaluate animation, then use view membership and visibility for frame assembly.
boundaries.openspore_concept: An immutable per-entity presentation snapshot derived from, but not writing back to, gameplay state.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IEntityView with setTransform, setOpacity, setAnimation, setVisible, and snapshot semantics.
boundaries.notes: The data flow is supported, but complete per-frame ordering and whether opacity directly drives visibility are unresolved.

boundaries.boundary: CellGFX world, layer, display, and mode-owned presentation stage
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell mode initialization and entry call cCellGFX Initialize, PreloadResources, StartDisplay, shutdown, and Dispose around gameplay updates.
boundaries.original_callee: cCellGFX::Initialize, PreloadResources, StartDisplay, Graphics layer and world virtuals, effects-world operations, lighting and shadow services, and CellGFX teardown helpers
state_changed: CellGFX world and layer handle table
boundaries.lifetime: The stage spans the Cell mode and outlives individual presentation views but not the mode.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Some setup failures produce a recorded status, but normal return can leave an incomplete graph; teardown is pointer-checked and best effort.
boundaries.timing_order: Create stage worlds, preload content, activate display and lighting context, update views, stop services, detach views, unregister layers, and release the graph.
boundaries.openspore_concept: A mode-owned scene stage coordinating views, resources, passes, and explicit activation without exposing renderer objects.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: ISceneStage with initialize, preload, startDisplay, stopDisplay, shutdown, and idempotent ownership transitions.
boundaries.notes: World and layer ordering is strongly supported. Lighting appearance remains a separate presentation-only concern.

boundaries.boundary: Effect presenter and entity-scoped effect-instance wrapper
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Gameplay effect events and cCellGFX paths request effect-map slots, foreground or background placement, and instance replacement.
boundaries.original_callee: cCellGFX::LoadEffectMap, cCellGFX::InstanceEffectOnCell, Swarm::IEffectsWorld::CreateVisualEffect, Swarm::EffectInstance, and IVisualEffect virtuals
state_changed: CellGFX effect slots and instance collections
boundaries.lifetime: Definitions belong to the world; instances live for the entity or effect-map lifetime and are stopped or released before their world and owning view.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Missing effect, parent, world, or creation failure is logged or returns a null handle; pointer-checked cleanup tolerates incomplete initialization.
boundaries.timing_order: Accept typed effect request, resolve world and definition, create instance, copy local and world transforms, update until stop, then release before view and world teardown.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Typed effect requests consumed by a presenter that returns independently owned visual-effect handles.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IEffectPresenter with create, update, stop, release, and explicit no-effect results.
boundaries.notes: This wrapper expresses a presentation operation; particle rendering inside it is not proven gameplay state.

boundaries.boundary: Material and texture content lookup service
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell preload and presentation material paths resolve selected material IDs and texture keys before model draw use.
boundaries.original_callee: Graphics::IMaterialManager, Graphics::ITextureManager, Graphics::MaterialShader::GetMaterialShader, and resource-manager lookup paths
state_changed: material or texture lookup cache state
boundaries.lifetime: Material definitions and texture resources are content- or cache-scoped; slot bindings and sampler state are shorter-lived.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Unknown material IDs return null; missing resources and unreadable records need explicit modern errors; the original lookup cache provides no ownership transfer.
boundaries.timing_order: Resolve material and texture identity, acquire content, bind definitions to meshes, then update short-lived draw state.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Content-addressed material definitions and texture assets, separate from compiled shaders and GPU descriptors.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IMaterialRegistry, ITextureStore, and IContentStore returning typed handles and explicit missing or unsupported outcomes.
boundaries.notes: The ID-to-definition association is required; linked-list, cache-pointer, and manager object layouts are not.

boundaries.boundary: Model, mesh, and model-world content and membership interface
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell, editor, terrain, and model presentation paths bind models and mesh resources to scenes and update transforms, animation, materials, LOD, and effects.
boundaries.original_callee: Graphics::IModelManager, Graphics::IModelWorld, Graphics::Model release and reference operations, model-world membership virtuals, and IModelWorld LOD and background-load anchors
state_changed: model reference count and shared ownership
boundaries.lifetime: Models and meshes are shared asset-scoped handles; model worlds and membership follow scene or object presentation lifetime.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Invalid handles and missing controllers become no-ops; release has no status; exact LOD and background-load failure behavior is unavailable.
boundaries.timing_order: Acquire shared content, create or bind a model world, synchronize gameplay-derived state, update membership and LOD, submit visible draws, then detach and release after retirement.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Shared model and mesh identity with scene membership and invalidatable presentation state.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IModelStore, ModelHandle, IModelWorld, and IModelView with membership, transform, LOD request, and last-owner release semantics.
boundaries.notes: The wrapper contract is useful, but exact model-world LOD and background-load behavior remains unresolved.

boundaries.boundary: Gameplay-derived renderable snapshot to renderer submission
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Camera, Cell, model, terrain, and editor presentation passes submit visible meshes and effects after gameplay updates.
boundaries.original_callee: Graphics::ILayer traversal, Graphics::IRenderer::Render and SubRender, Graphics::GlobalState::SetTransform, model-world draw state, and downstream RenderWare draw submission
parameters: layer, pass, topology, and draw order
state_changed: backend stream, material, and draw state
boundaries.lifetime: Submission records are frame- or pass-scoped; visible scene membership, transform snapshots, and material resources are longer-lived.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Missing renderers, transforms, materials, or services cause presentation failure; no reviewed path converts a backend draw failure into gameplay state.
boundaries.timing_order: Freeze gameplay-derived snapshots, update camera and culling, build ordered draw items, apply per-draw state, submit the pass, and present after all dependent work.
boundaries.openspore_concept: A narrow scene submission interface carrying stable renderable identity and state without backend objects.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IRenderQueue or IRenderCommandEncoder accepting mesh, world transform, material, layer, and pass order.
boundaries.notes: The entity transform and draw ordering are semantic; global state pointers, RW objects, and D3D calls are not.

boundaries.boundary: Scene graph layer, world, model-world, and shadow attachment wrapper
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell and editor modes attach scene layers, model worlds, and shadow relationships to mode-owned presentation graphs.
boundaries.original_callee: Graphics::IRenderer::Layer and UnregisterLayer, Graphics::IShadowWorld::SetShadowMapLayer and AddModelWorld, and ILayer or IModelWorld attachment virtuals
parameters: setup, replacement, pause, or teardown phase
boundaries.lifetime: Attachments follow their mode, cell, or editor presentation owner and are replaced or detached before teardown.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Original methods expose little status; conflict handling, null service behavior, and exact detach failure are not runtime-observed.
boundaries.timing_order: Acquire handles, attach scene and shadow relationships, populate views, pause or leave the mode, then detach and release in reverse ownership order.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Typed scene attachment and teardown relationships using opaque world, layer, and model-world handles.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: ISceneAttachment with attachLayer, attachModelWorld, detach, setVisibility, and setShadowLayer transitions.
boundaries.notes: This is a gameplay-facing engine wrapper even when the attached object ultimately reaches RenderWare.

boundaries.boundary: Shared model, mesh, texture, effect, pose, and presentation-handle lifetime
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell preload, entity presentation, model-world, editor, and stage teardown paths retain and release shared visual resources across use.
boundaries.original_callee: Graphics::Model reference operations, resource intrusive handles, CellGFX preload lists, model-world final release, and IVisualEffect release paths
boundaries.lifetime: Handles remain live through preload, scene membership, submission, and any in-flight GPU work; retirement begins only after the last semantic owner detaches.

boundaries.timing_order: Retain before registration, borrow during scene use, detach, drop the last semantic reference, and retire backend resources only after dependent work is complete.
boundaries.openspore_concept: Shared ownership with separate semantic, scene, and backend-retirement lifetimes.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: Shared ModelHandle, TextureHandle, MeshHandle, EffectHandle, and explicit retirement acknowledgements or invalid-handle results.
boundaries.notes: Strong shared lifetime is required. Original refcount offsets, terminal vtable slots, and GPU teardown timing are not modern contracts.

boundaries.boundary: Cell effect-map selection and visual effect appearance
boundaries.gameplay_caller: Cell mode and gameplay effect events cause effect-map records and instances to appear, but no reviewed path shows the particle result mutating health, movement, or combat state.
boundaries.original_callee: cCellGFX::LoadEffectMap and InstanceEffectOnCell through effect-world and IVisualEffect presentation methods

boundaries.lifetime: Effect slots and instances follow Cell presentation and are replaced or released independently of the gameplay event.
boundaries.failure_semantics: Unsupported record types, missing effects, or failed starts skip or omit the visual instance; no gameplay failure is established.
boundaries.timing_order: Resolve effect identity, create or replace the instance, update visual parameters, render, then stop or release it with the owner.
boundaries.openspore_concept: A visual-effect request and presenter result with no implied gameplay state mutation.
boundaries.modern_abstraction: IEffectView over typed effect IDs and parameters, separate from effect presenter ownership.
boundaries.notes: The event that requests an effect may be gameplay-relevant; the effect instance and its appearance are presentation-only under current evidence.

boundaries.boundary: Cursor, drop icon, and screen-overlay presentation

boundaries.original_callee: UTFWin::cCursorManager::SetActiveCursor and ShowDropCursorIcon, UTFWin::Window::GetCursorID, and UI::cLayerManager::Get
boundaries.lifetime: Cursor and overlay state follow the active window or mode interaction and are replaced on exit.

boundaries.modern_abstraction: ICursorService and IOverlayLayerStack over host cursor and compositor state.

boundaries.boundary: Projection-derived frustum and render-bounds visibility culling

boundaries.modern_abstraction: ICameraFrustum and renderer visibility testing with a separately named semantic visibility query if gameplay later consumes it.

boundaries.boundary: Cell health-rollover HUD pixels and expiry state

boundaries.boundary: Lighting-world activation, shadow reset, and rendered lighting appearance

boundaries.lifetime: World and shadow state follows Cell presentation or renderer-device lifetime.

boundaries.boundary: Vertex-stream, index-buffer, topology, and indexed mesh draw mechanics
